definitions.explanation: A structure built around a property for privacy or security, typically made of concrete, wood, or bamboo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{塀|へい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧。
examples.english: A house surrounded by a tall wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塀|へい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The child climbed over the fence.
We built a fence on the boundary with our neighbor.

notes:
USAGE: {塀|へい} refers specifically to walls/fences around properties, not interior walls or national borders.

TYPES:
・⟦{板塀|いたべい}→板塀：28264_itabei⟧ (wooden fence)
・⟦{ブロック塀|ブロックべい}→ブロック塀：28373_burokkubei⟧ (concrete block wall)
・⟦{石塀|いしべい}→石塀：28374_ishibei⟧ (stone wall)
・⟦{竹垣|たけがき}→竹垣：27396_takegaki⟧ (bamboo fence)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{塀|へい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build a fence)
・{塀|へい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧ (to climb over a fence)
・{塀|へい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれる→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (to be surrounded by a wall)

RELATED:
・⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ - wall (interior/building wall)
・⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧ - fence (simpler barrier)
